name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Stratified Outcome Counts
description: Yearly ZCTA-level respiratory diseases qualifying MedPAR inpatient admission counts for the `resp_diseases__icdcodeset001__dx1__all_admissions` definition, stratified by age group, sex, race, RTI race/ethnicity, dual eligibility, and Medicare buy-in status.

content.state: String: Two-letter state abbreviation when available
content.n_admissions: Int64: Number of respiratory diseases qualifying MedPAR inpatient admissions
content.sex: String: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values follow MBSF/ResDAC coding: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: String: SSA beneficiary race code. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: String: RTI enhanced race and ethnicity code. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.dual: Int32: Dual Medicare-Medicaid eligibility indicator; 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual eligible
content.buyin: Int32: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B. Code values: 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none.
